literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jichou day the Sanggan and Yang Rivers overflowed west of Juyong Pass, nearly destroying the grain crop; many dwellings of residents of Fengsheng and Nanjing were inundated.
idiomatic: On jichou day in the seventh autumn month the Sanggan and Yang Rivers overflowed west of Juyong Pass and nearly destroyed the grain crop; many homes in Fengsheng and Nanjing were flooded.

literal: In the eighth month the court went to Autumn Mountain.
idiomatic: In the eighth month the court went to Autumn Mountain.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on the jiashen new moon the court halted at Pugui Slope.
idiomatic: On the jiashen new moon of the tenth winter month the court halted at Pugui Slope.

literal: That year jinshi Wang Xizai and one other were passed and granted degree.
idiomatic: That year jinshi Wang Xizai and one other passed the examinations.

literal: In the twelfth year, spring, first month, on the guichou new moon waters at Huoyin Town flooded and drowned more than thirty villages; an edict ordered the old canal dredged.
idiomatic: On the guichou new moon of the first spring month in the twelfth year, flooding at Huoyin Town drowned more than thirty villages, and an edict ordered the old canal dredged.

literal: On jiayin day co-chancellor of the Secretariat Yelü Shuolao was made tiyin.
idiomatic: On jiayin day co-chancellor of the Secretariat Yelü Shuolao was appointed tiyin.

literal: An edict restored land tax within fifty li of the traveling palace.

literal: On yimao day the court visited Yanfang Marsh.
idiomatic: On yimao day the court visited Yanfang Marsh.

idiomatic: On gengshen day langjun Yelü Bise and others plotted rebellion and were executed.

idiomatic: On renxu day Southern Court Great King Yelü Jing was appointed Shangjing military commissioner and enfeoffed Duke of Qishui Commandery.

literal: Li Zaiyou of Bazhou, a commoner aged one hundred thirty-three, was granted silk, a brocade robe, and a silver belt, given monthly rations of mutton and wine, and his household was exempted from service.
idiomatic: Li Zaiyou, a commoner of Bazhou aged one hundred thirty-three, was granted silk, a brocade robe, and a silver belt, given monthly rations of mutton and wine, and his household was exempted from service.

idiomatic: On wuxu day, because the stone image of Emperor Jingzong was completed, the court visited Yanshou Temple and fed the monks.

idiomatic: The Iron Li came with tribute.

idiomatic: On the wuyin new moon of the twelfth month there was a solar eclipse.

idiomatic: On gengyin day vagrant laborers were forbidden.

idiomatic: On jiayin day Guangling County was established.
